articles.title: Kate Bishop Actress Hailee Steinfeld Confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has confirmed Kate Bishop actress Hailee Steinfeld as a last-minute addition to the cast of Avengers: Doomsday. Marvel Studios announced the surprise return of Hawkeye's Disney+ partner in a nonchalant Instagram reel tonight.
body: "Catch Hailee Steinfeld in Disney's Hexed before she returns in Avengers: Doomsday," the post said.

You'd be forgiven for thinking Steinfeld was already included in Doomsday's already enormous lineup of superheroes and A-listers. Everyone from Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal to Tom Hiddleston has previously been confirmed to make an appearance of some kind, but Steinfeld was one of a few names to have been curiously benched up until this point.

She first appeared as the bow-wielding Kate Bishop in the Jeremy Renner-led 2021 show, Hawkeye. Aside from a The Marvels cameo and some animated voice work, Steinfeld hasn't spent too much time in the Marvel Cinematic Universe as the multiverse saga has rolled on. That won't stop her from helping out in the first chapter of its finale, though.

With the cast already stacked, it's hard to know just how prominently her character will be featured amongst the chaos. Between the Avengers, the New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men, there will likely be little room to explore how she gets along with the rest of the crew. For many, just the fact that she'll help in the fight against Doctor Doom is probably enough.
points: Marvel Studios has confirmed Kate Bishop actress Hailee Steinfeld as a last-minute addition to the cast of Avengers: Doomsday.
Marvel Studios announced the surprise return of Hawkeye's Disney+ partner in a nonchalant Instagram reel tonight.
"Catch Hailee Steinfeld in Disney's Hexed before she returns in Avengers: Doomsday," the post said.
She first appeared as the bow-wielding Kate Bishop in the Jeremy Renner-led 2021 show, Hawkeye.

articles.title: Samsung Nintendo Switch 2 MicroSD Express Memory Cards Are on Sale for Black Friday
articles.summary: Several Black Friday deals on Nintendo Switch 2 accessories and video games are already under way. One of the most welcome deals is on Switch 2 memory. Ahead of November 27, Amazon has dropped the price of the highly rated Samsung P9 256GB Micro SDXC Express Card to $44.99 with free shipping.
body: The Switch 2 only comes with 256GB of onboard storage and it will run out faster than you think. If you have a standard MicroSD card from your previous Switch, it won't work on the Switch 2. Although the two might look similar, the MicroSD Express card is much faster than its predecessor. The Samsung P9 model boasts transfer speeds of up to 800MB/s.

Quite a few games have now been released for the Switch 2 and some of them require an enormous amount of space. Final Fantasy 14 is the most gigabyte-hungry game to date, requiring about 117GB all by itself. That game alone takes up half of the Switch 2's internal storage capacity. Other plus-sized games include Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade (90GB), Split Fiction (70GB), Cyberpunk 2077 (60GB), and Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment (44GB). The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time tops out at about 27GB. Nowadays it's completely possible to download just three or four games and find yourself completely out of onboard storage.
points: Several Black Friday deals on Nintendo Switch 2 accessories and video games are already under way.
One of the most welcome deals is on Switch 2 memory.
Ahead of November 27, Amazon has dropped the price of the highly rated Samsung P9 256GB Micro SDXC Express Card to $44.99 with free shipping.
If you have a standard MicroSD card from your previous Switch, it won't work on the Switch 2.

articles.title: The PlayStation 5 Pro Console Is Going In and Out of Stock at Amazon
articles.summary: The PlayStation 5 Pro will certainly not be discounted on Black Friday. In fact, you'd be lucky just to find one for retail price. Fortunately, Amazon appears to be restocking PlayStation 5 Pro consoles on a very sporadic basis. You can't just buy the console alone, you'll need to select a bundle.
body: The PlayStation 5 Pro console was released on November of 2024. This is a more powerful version of the standard PS5 console. Normally you would have to choose between "Quality mode" with true 4K graphics and a lower 30fps max framerate or a "Performance mode" with upscaled 1440p (or lower) graphics with up to 60fps max framerate. However, thanks to the power of the new PS5 Pro console, you can get native 4K resolution and up to 60fps max framerate in many if not most games. It doesn't include a disc drive as standard. You'd need to buy an add-on disc drive unit for $79.

After thirteen years of waiting, GTA 6 is finally out. IGN's Luke Reilly gave it a well-deserved 10/10 "Masterpiece" rating. I'm pretty convinced that no other game will be played on PlayStation or Xbox consoles in the days following. According to Jackie's GTA 6 performance analysis, the PS5 Pro is currently the best way to play the game. Just note that you're still locked at 30fps, but you'll benefit from the additional horsepower along with ray tracing and VRR tech.
points: The PlayStation 5 Pro will certainly not be discounted on Black Friday.
Fortunately, Amazon appears to be restocking PlayStation 5 Pro consoles on a very sporadic basis.
The PlayStation 5 Pro console was released on November of 2024.
This is a more powerful version of the standard PS5 console.

articles.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Plows Through GTA 6 Hype With $225 Million Opening Weekend
articles.summary: The latest prequel in Suzanne Collins' run of Hunger Games adaptations attracted more than just fans, pulling in a whopping $125 million domestically and $105 million internationally following its November 20 release date.
body: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping took GTA 6 players off of their couches and into movie theaters with a staggering estimated box office total of $225 million in its opening weekend.

Attracting moviegoers to take a break from Vice City this weekend was star Joseph Zada (We Were Liars), who stars as a young Haymitch Abernathy to tell the story of the Second Quarter Quell and the impact it had on the Hunger Games for all time. A brutal flick that IGN gave an 8/10 review, Sunrise on the Reaping is an adaptation of Collins' book of the same name, which originally released in March 2025. Its star-studded cast also includes Jesse Plemons (Game Night) as Plutarch Heavensbee, Ralph Fiennes (28 Years Later) as President Snow, Glenn Close (Fatal Attraction) as Drusilla Sickle, Mckenna Grace (Five Nights at Freddy's 2) as Maysilee Donner, and more.

"The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is one of the strongest entries of the franchise because of its excellent performances," we said in our review, "especially Joseph Zada’s compassionate turn as young Haymitch. It also closes the story of Panem on a high note."

articles.title: Robert Pattinson's Forgotten Dark Fantasy Thriller Proves He's a Perfect James Bond
articles.summary: Not everybody is convinced Robert Pattinson is the right choice to be the next James Bond. Some are complaining Bond should be played by someone less famous, like he has in the past. Others feel he’s not masculine enough, or good-looking enough, or charismatic enough.
body: Honestly, I do think there is some merit to the idea that Bond should be played by an up-and-comer, if only because that’s been the tradition. (Clearly Amazon, which took over the franchise in 2025, has other ideas.) As for the more cosmetic complaints, I guess those all come down to personal taste.

As for the Twilight-related concerns, I understand them because, when Pattinson was announced as Batman back in 2019, I thought​​​​​​​ “Oh no, the Twilight guy? How could this guy, who seemed so… soft, be the Dark Knight?” I hated the idea. Then, a few months after the announcement, I saw the Robert Eggers film The Lighthouse and completely changed my mind.

The Lighthouse really is just about two guys in a lighthouse dealing with the loneliness of the job, which requires them to be stuck at sea for weeks at a time. Dafoe plays a grouchy old sea-dog, while Pattinson is his young apprentice. The movie is a laugh riot, with lots of drinking, some wild singing, and both men becoming increasingly unhinged. One dreams he has sex with a mermaid, the other masturbates all the time, and both are brought to their breaking point by the end.

articles.title: 34 Years Later, the Best 'Far Side' Quote Will Still Leave You Speechless
articles.summary: Larson didn’t do deep and inspirational. Many of his cartoons required you to think, but not because they were thoughtful. Larson’s work was brilliant, and it sometimes took a few minutes to figure out what the punchline was.
body: In recent months, I’ve been examining the best-ever quotes from various newspaper comic strips, and in that time I’ve determined that every comic strip requires its own approach. For Charles Schulz’s Peanuts, I chose something heartfelt and inspirational because those comics and characters really have inspired people. For Bill Watterson’s Calvin and Hobbes, I investigated something more philosophical, as the best of those comics make the audience contemplate human nature and the world around them. But for Gary Larson’s The Far Side, the task is monumentally different.
Larson’s work often requires the reader to investigate something, but usually not in any kind of overly deep way.

The Far Side is brilliant, but it's not the kind of comic strip that makes you ponder life’s big questions. Larson channeled his genius into joke-telling, and that’s what made The Far Side so sharply funny. As such, determining Larson’s best-ever Far Side quote shouldn’t be some insightful, inspirational, or thoughtful journey — even though I did try going that way at first.
points: Many of his cartoons required you to think, but not because they were thoughtful.
Larson’s work was brilliant, and it sometimes took a few minutes to figure out what the punchline was.

articles.title: Binding of Isaac DLC adds AI music in GTA 6-parodying update despite not having an AI disclosure, Steam reviews drop to Overwhelmingly Negative, music gets pulled
articles.summary: Jody's first computer was a Commodore 64, so he remembers having to use a code wheel to play Pool of Radiance. A former music journalist who interviewed everyone from Giorgio Moroder to Trent Reznor, Jody also co-hosted Australia's first radio show about videogames,
body: While most videogames got out of the way of Grand Theft Auto 6, on the day of its release The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth's free online DLC Repentance+ released an update. It included an easter egg daily challenge called Crime Mode (the seed is V1CE BSMT) with references to GTA like a wanted rating, guns, cops, and cars. Well, driveable minecarts.

What should have been an easy PR win for publisher Nicalis quickly turned sour as players pointed out that the music in Crime Mode sure sounds AI-generated. "It has that 'tinniness' that something like Suno generated music has", user ShweetStuff noted before looking at the music files and finding that, yep, there was Suno metadata in the file comments. Yet there was no AI disclosure on the DLC's Steam page.

Players were not thrilled by this development. Steam user reviews on The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ dropped to Overwhelmingly Negative, with only 8% positive recent reviews. Players put the blame on Nicalis, who licence Binding of Isaac from its original creator Edmund McMillen. "Edmund please take back control of the game", one said.

articles.title: Star Wars Is Getting an Official IMAX 70mm Release for the First Time
articles.summary: Han will shoot first in 70 mm IMAX when the original Star Wars returns to movie theaters next year. Lucasfilm and IMAX have confirmed that the 50th anniversary rerelease of Star Wars will be on the biggest screens possible next February, giving fans a strong reason to return to theaters.
body: In an official announcement on StarWars.com, Lucasfilm says Star Wars "will be shown across a select number of IMAX 70 mm film locations as well as playing in select theaters for a limited time."

That's not the only Star Wars release getting the deluxe IMAX treatment next year. Lucasfilm and IMAX reconfirmed that next year's stand-alone adventure Star Wars: Starfighter is also coming to the large-screen format. On May 28, 2027, Lucasfilm will release Star Wars: Starfighter, which was filmed for IMAX, shot with IMAX-certified film cameras, and converted to IMAX 70 mm film prints for release in a select number of IMAX film locations, according to an official announcement.

Star Wars: Starfighter is directed by Shawn Levy ( Deadpool & Wolverine, Stranger Things ) and stars Ryan Gosling ( Blade Runner 2049, Barbie ) as Kade Auberon, "a cynical rogue" who is "hurled into a dangerous adventure across the galaxy that puts him on a crash course with destiny." Starfighter also stars Matt Smith, Mia Goth, Aaron Pierre, Jamael Westman, Daniel Ings, Flynn Gray, and Amy Adams. The movie was written by Jonathan Tropper ( Warrior, The Adam Project ).

body: Warlords 4 was the final turn-based game in the beloved series, with the RTS spin-off series Warlords Battlecry already two games deep by the time of its release in 2003. This updated version supports resolutions up to 4K, and incorporates community fixes and a community-made campaign. It's available on Steam and GOG.

You'd choose a squad of eight from your platoon of 32 each mission, fighting through a campaign that started in North Africa and ended in Germany, gaining experience along the way. SNEG's version supports 1280x720 widescreen resolution. It's available on Steam and GOG.

articles.title: Nvidia released a hotfix for its driver hammering your SSD, but it doesn't actually work
articles.summary: Jody's first computer was a Commodore 64, so he remembers having to use a code wheel to play Pool of Radiance. A former music journalist who interviewed everyone from Giorgio Moroder to Trent Reznor, Jody also co-hosted Australia's first radio show about videogames,
body: Over the last couple of weeks, some Nvidia users noticed their SSDs were taking a hammering, reporting their driver's log file was being overwritten constantly, sometimes to the tune of 30 GB every hour. Which obviously isn't great for the lifespan of the valuable SSD you've got it installed on.

Given the problem was caused by recent driver updates, rolling back to version 621.01 was the best solution until Nvidia could do something about it. Which they did, releasing a hotfix as version 621.35. It's not available in the GeForce app yet, but you can download it directly from Nvidia's site. Not that you should.

As users on the Nvidia subreddit are reporting, the problem persists. While the hotfix reduces the peak write rate and prevents it for a short while after reboot, it eventually creeps back in. One user reported that overnight the log file was still being rewritten by approximately 4.5 GB every hour.

articles.title: GTA 6's strong and silent Jason was inspired by Steve McQueen and former Army Rangers, says Rockstar
articles.summary: If you've noticed that Grand Theft Auto 6 's Jason Duval isn't much of a talker, that's by design, as his quiet nature was inspired by Steve McQueen and the studio's research into former Army Rangers.
body: Speaking to Destructoid over email, Rockstar's senior vice president of narrative, Rupert Humphries, explained that the team looked at classic couple-on-the-run films when it decided on GTA 6's story.

"When we decided we wanted to tell a story about a couple on the run, we looked at all the similar kinds of movies, and one of the ones that really stood out was Peckinpah's The Getaway," Humphries said. "Steve McQueen was famous for pulling lines out of scripts and saying things with his presence alone. We wanted to see how close we could get to that with a game character, where so many of our protagonists have been the opposite."

That approach also fitted the studio's research into veterans. "This also resonated with the research we were doing around veterans and particularly former Army Rangers (in our world we call them Marauders)," Humphries continued. "These guys typically aren't running their mouths or reacting to something unless it's strictly necessary, while still being strong and still asserting themselves."
Game writer Michael Wiafe said Florida's real-life crime stories were "an obvious starting point" for GTA 6's characters more broadly.
points: If you've noticed that Grand Theft Auto 6 's Jason Duval isn't much of a talker, that's by design, as his quiet nature was inspired by Steve McQueen and the studio's research into former Army Rangers.

articles.title: GTA 6 player gets 30-day PSN ban for sharing in-game nudist photo with a friend
articles.summary: A Grand Theft Auto 6 player says they've been hit with a 30-day PlayStation Network social features ban after sending a friend a photo they took in the game's nudist resort.
body: Posting on Twitter/X on Friday evening, DerrickGott007 said they had "just got a 30-day PSN social features ban" for sending the photo, which they'd taken with the in-game camera, through PlayStation's messaging service, warning other players not to do the same.

"Do not, I repeat do not send any photos taken with the in-game camera, across the PSN messaging network that contain nudity," they wrote. "I just got a 30-day PSN social features ban for sending my friend a photo of the nudist colony in GTA6 that I found."

In a screenshot of the notice, PlayStation Safety says that content sent from the player's account via Message on PlayStation "breached the Code of Conduct", and that their account has been "temporarily suspended from using PlayStation social features for 30 days" due to "pornographic or obscene content". It also warns that "further offenses may result in temporary or permanent suspension from the whole of PlayStation, not just social features".
points: A Grand Theft Auto 6 player says they've been hit with a 30-day PlayStation Network social features ban after sending a friend a photo they took in the game's nudist resort.
